name: Floral White
lede: Floral White is a computer color name: one of the 140 colors in the X11 set, a white with a faint warm tint.

sections.title: One of 140
sections.body: Paterson's dictionary counts Floral White among the 140 colours of the X11 set and gives its hex code as #FFFAF0 [1]. In his color-by-hue index it appears in the whites, next to Ghost White, Ivory and Antique White [2]. The name belongs to a naming convention, not to a pigment or a flower with a documented history [1][2].

sections.title: Close neighbors
sections.body: Its near relatives are [[ghost-white]], which leans cool, and [[ivory]], [[linen]] and [[white]] itself [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The hex #FFFAF0 measures lightness 98.4, chroma 5.4 and hue angle 90 degrees, so it is a yellowish white, warmer than pure white [3]. On a phone screen the tint is hard to see unless the swatch sits next to true white [3]. In plain numbers, the hex #FFFAF0 sets red at 255, green at 250 and blue at 240, so the tint comes from blue sitting a little lower than the other two channels [3]. Paterson lists other pale X11 names too, such as Beige (#F5F5DC), which is a deeper step in the same warm direction [1].
